subject: Fifth Grade Puberty Curriculum Presentation
overview: Medford Public Schools staff presented the updated fifth-grade health curriculum to caregivers and answered questions regarding lesson content, inclusive practices, and student support.

items.title: Welcome and Opening Remarks
items.summary: Staff opened the meeting and outlined the purpose of providing caregivers an overview of the fifth-grade puberty instruction.

items.title: Fifth-Grade Puberty Curriculum Presentation
items.summary: Physical Education and Health Director Rachel Perry detailed the three-lesson "Puberty Happens" curriculum, which covers physical and social-emotional changes, classroom agreements, anonymous question boxes, and basic hygiene.

items.title: Caregiver Questions and Discussion
items.summary: Staff answered caregiver questions regarding curriculum scope, instructional dates, inclusive language, student IEP accommodations, and school feminine product dispensers.
